title: 第一卷 正文第3章 灵者六重天第一卷 正文第4章 猛虎爪
content_zh:
“虽然我没了灵炎血脉，但有混沌宝塔在，拥有百倍的时间流速加持的我，就算是极品血脉的天才，也比不上我！”楚凌天眼中精芒闪烁，充满信心。
“炎蛟血脉作为七品血脉，确实很强。但和拥有百倍时间流速的我相比，简直就是云泥之别！况且，现在的我实力弱小，只能进入混沌宝塔第一层。等我实力精进后，进入混沌宝塔第二层、第三层……时间速度说不定会更快！”楚凌天自语道。
他深呼吸一口气，将激动的情绪平复，仔细梳理一下信息，制定了一套修炼计划后。意念一动，重新回到房间内。
楚凌天从枕头底下，拿出仅剩下的一百两银票，离开楚府，一次性购买了两年的干粮，和一些基础药材的种子。然后返回房间，意念一动，带着干粮、水和药材种子，来到宝塔第一层空间。
他打算直接闭关两年。
“等有钱了，可以直接购买辟谷丹，就不需要准备这么多干粮和水了。”楚凌天无奈地叹了一口气。
之前的他，作为风云城楚家分支第一天才，自然是不缺钱的。但五天前，他被楚山抽离了灵炎血脉，沦为废人后。他这些年积攒下来的家当，都被其他族人哄抢了，只藏下一张一百两的银票。
楚凌天先是走进田地，将药材种子种下。
然后来到蒲团前，盘腿坐下，调整好状态后，双手结出修炼手印，运转《火云诀》，开始修炼。
九州大陆将功法、武技，共分为四大品阶。由低到高分别是：黄阶、玄阶、地阶、天阶。每个品阶又细分为低级、中级、高级，三个等级。
楚凌天修炼的《火云诀》，乃是黄阶高级功法，是风云城楚家分支的家传功法，只有嫡系子孙才能修炼。
不论是修炼功法，还是修炼武技，都有着五重境界，分别是：初入、小成、中成、大成、圆满。
之前的楚凌天，虽然是风云城楚家分支第一天才，但也只是将《火云诀》，修炼至了小成之境而已。
功法、武技的五重境界之间，差距极大。
楚凌天，若是能将《火云诀》修炼至中成之境，吸收天地灵气的速度将提升一倍以上，若是能修炼至大成之境，吸收天地灵气的速度将提升三倍以上……
时间飞逝，一晃，两年的时间便过去。
在这两年中，楚凌天除了吃饭、偶尔照看药材外，其余时间都用来修炼了。
虽然楚凌天的根基修复了，可以重新修炼，但由于灵炎血脉被抽离，变成了没有血脉的废柴，资质一落千丈，修炼速度缓慢无比。但好在，他的悟性还在。
再加上，他之前的修炼经验，以及药材的辅助。
两年的刻苦修炼，让他的修为恢复到了灵者六重天后期。

除此之外，他还将功法《火云诀》修炼至中成之境，武技《火云掌》修炼至大成之境。战力虽然比不上原来，但足以和灵者七重天修士一战。
“灵者六重天后期远远不够，想要在生死对决中斩杀楚浩辰，不仅要恢复原来的修为，还得更进一步才行。”楚凌天沉声道。
楚浩辰觉醒的紫火血脉，虽然只是三品血脉，但他作为家主的二儿子，获得的修炼资源甚至比楚凌天还要多。
他的修为虽然不如之前的楚凌天，但也达到了灵者九重天初期。
所以，想要战胜楚浩辰，以楚凌天现在的实力，还远远不够。
楚凌天见干粮已经见底，便结束了修炼，起身伸了个懒腰。
“基础药材对我的帮助已经微乎其微。以我现在的修为，只有一品以上的药材，才能起到效果。”楚凌天自语道。
九州大陆，将药材按照药效，分为九个品阶。由低到高分别是：一品药材、二品药材、三品药材……九品药材。
而楚凌天之前购买的药材种子，都是最基础的药材，一两年就可以成熟，连一品药材都不是，药效非常弱。
“得想办法弄一批一品药材才行。”
楚凌天思索了许久后，意念一动，离开宝塔第一层空间，回到外界。
虽然楚凌天在宝塔第一层空间内，足足修炼了两年的时间。但外界才过去了七天。
“混沌宝塔不愧是无上至尊炼制的绝世至宝，有它在，未来我必将踏上修士之巅！”楚凌天嘴角噙上一抹自信的笑容。
就在这时，别院的院门突然炸裂。一名身穿锦衣、脸色阴冷的少年，带着两名下人，气势汹汹冲了进来。
“楚凌天！你竟敢私藏银票，谁给你的胆子！”少年嚣张地喊道。
content_en:
"Although I don't have the Spirit Flame bloodline, with the Chaos Pagoda here and the blessing of a hundred times the speed of time, even a genius with the best bloodline can't compare to me!" Chu Lingtian's eyes flashed with full confidence.
"As a seventh-grade bloodline, the Yanjiao bloodline is indeed very strong. But compared to me, who has a hundred times the speed of time, there is a huge difference! Besides, I am weak now and can only enter the first floor of the Chaos Pagoda. When my strength improves, I can enter the second and third floors of the Chaos Pagoda... the time speed may be even faster!" Chu Lingtian said to himself.
He took a deep breath to calm down his excitement, carefully sorted out the information, and formulated a training plan. With a thought, he returned to the room.
Chu Lingtian took out the remaining one hundred taels of silver notes from under his pillow, left the Chu Mansion, and purchased two years of dry food and some basic medicinal seeds at once. Then he returned to the room, and with a thought, brought dry food, water and medicinal seeds to the first floor of the pagoda.
He planned to go into seclusion for two years.
"When you have money, you can buy Bigu Pill directly, and you won't need to prepare so much dry food and water." Chu Lingtian sighed helplessly.
Previously, as the number one genius of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City, he was naturally not short of money. But five days ago, he was separated from the spirit flame bloodline by Chushan and became a useless queen. All the belongings he had accumulated over the years had been robbed by other tribesmen, leaving only a one hundred tael silver note hidden.
Chu Lingtian first walked into the field and planted the medicinal seeds.
Then he came to the futon, sat down cross-legged, and after adjusting his condition, formed the cultivation mudra with both hands, ran the "Fire Cloud Technique", and started practicing.
Kyushu Continent divides martial arts and martial arts into four major levels. From low to high they are: Huang level, Xuan level, Earth level and Tian level. Each grade is subdivided into three levels: low-level, intermediate, and high-level.
The "Fire Cloud Technique" practiced by Chu Lingtian is an advanced Huang-level skill. It is a ancestral skill of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City and can only be practiced by direct descendants.
Whether you are practicing martial arts or practicing martial arts, there are five levels of realms, namely: initial entry, small success, medium success, great success, and perfection.
Although the previous Chu Lingtian was the number one genius of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City, he had only practiced the "Fire Cloud Art" to a small level.
There is a huge gap between the five realms of martial arts and martial arts.
Chu Lingtian, if he can practice "Fire Cloud Jue" to the state of Zhongcheng, the speed of absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth will be more than doubled. If he can practice it to the state of Dacheng, the speed of absorbing spiritual energy of heaven and earth will be increased by more than three times...
Time flies, and in a blink of an eye, two years have passed.
In the past two years, except for eating and occasionally taking care of medicinal materials, Chu Lingtian spent the rest of his time practicing.
Although Chu Lingtian's foundation was repaired and he could practice again, because the spirit flame bloodline was extracted and he became a useless person without bloodline, his qualifications plummeted and his cultivation speed was extremely slow. But fortunately, his understanding is still there.
In addition, his previous cultivation experience and the assistance of medicinal materials.
Two years of hard training allowed his cultivation to return to the late stage of the sixth level of the Spiritual Realm.
In addition, he also practiced the martial arts "Fire Cloud Jue" to the state of intermediate perfection, and the martial arts "Fire Cloud Palm" to the state of great achievement. Although the combat power is not as good as before, it is enough to fight against the seventh-level spiritual monks.
"The late stage of the Sixth Heaven of Spirits is far from enough. If you want to kill Chu Haochen in a life-and-death duel, you must not only restore your original cultivation level, but also go one step further." Chu Lingtian said solemnly.
Although Chu Haochen's awakened purple fire bloodline was only a third-grade bloodline, as the second son of the family head, he received even more training resources than Chu Lingtian.
Although his cultivation level is not as good as that of Chu Lingtian before him, he has also reached the early stage of the Ninth Level Spiritual Heaven.
Therefore, if you want to defeat Chu Haochen, Chu Lingtian's current strength is not enough.
Chu Lingtian had already seen dry foodAt the end of the day, he ended his practice, stood up and stretched.
"Basic medicinal materials have been of minimal help to me. With my current level of cultivation, only medicinal materials of first grade or above can be effective." Chu Lingtian said to himself.
In Kyushu Continent, medicinal materials are divided into nine grades according to their medicinal effects. From low to high, they are: first-grade medicinal materials, second-grade medicinal materials, third-grade medicinal materials... ninth-grade medicinal materials.
The medicinal seeds that Chu Lingtian purchased before were all basic medicinal materials that would mature in one or two years. They were not even first-grade medicinal materials, and their efficacy was very weak.
"We have to find a way to get a batch of first-grade medicinal materials."
After Chu Lingtian thought for a long time, he left the first level of the pagoda and returned to the outside world.
Although Chu Lingtian had been practicing in the first level of the pagoda for two years. But only seven days have passed in the outside world.
"The Chaos Pagoda is indeed a peerless treasure refined by the Supreme Being. With it, I will definitely reach the top of the monks in the future!" A confident smile appeared on Chu Lingtian's lips.
At this moment, the door of the other courtyard suddenly exploded. A young man wearing brocade clothes and a grim face rushed in aggressively with two servants.
"Chu Lingtian! How dare you hide the banknotes secretly? Who gave you the courage!" The young man shouted arrogantly.
